
# Notes on SNV2.2 and SNV2.3
## Introduction
  Here we try to reproduce the analysis of SNV2.2 and SNV2.3 as done by Shreya from her codes and data. Learn about [Mittheilungen Data](./mittheilungen_data.qmd) and [Source Book Data](./source_book_data.qmd). And additinal data added by Shreya are explored. Note that unless sepcified, the data used here are from Shreya's data. 

We try to apply the same modifications to Mittheilungen data as done in Shreya's codes, and add the data from source mentioned in @bhattacharya2024. And try to make a [All Combined Data](./all_combined_data.qmd) set that includes all data sources and changes to Mittheilungen.

Starting from September 2025, we started working with Mittheilungen Data from SILSO data base. So there will be additional analysis files like [Mittheilungen New](./mittheilungen_data-new.qmd) and [Mittheilungen Data 1800](./mittheilungen_data-1800.qmd)
